sentences.text:
Author: P. Sree Sudha
Bench: P. Sree Sudha
 The Honourable Smt Justice P. Sree Sudha
 Civil Revision Petition No. 103 Of 2024
Order:
This Civil Revision Petition is filed aggrieved by the order dated 08.12.2023 passed in I.A.No.1105 of 2023 in M.V.O.P.No.103 of 2021, on the file of Principal District Judge (MACT), Karimnagar.

2. Heard learned counsel for the revision petitioner and learned counsel for respondents.
3.

Learned counsel for the revision petitioner contended that petitioner filed I.A.No.1105 of 2023 in M.V.O.P.No.103 of 2021 seeking consequential amendment in column No.13 and also in other columns and also stated that he has taken further treatment in various hospitals and incurred further expenditure and thus asked for enhancement of amount under the heads medical expenditure, extra nourishment and transportation and attendant charges and accordingly requested for enhancement.

The trial Court observed that if it is an application filed for enhancement of compensation, petitioner can seek the same by giving his testimony but he is seeking amendment in each and every column of the claim petition though it was filed in the year 2021.
4. Learned counsel for the revision petitioner further stated that as the case is under Motor Vehicle Act as on beneficial legislation, petitioner is entitled for just compensation as such he filed an application for enhancement of the compensation and to substantiate his version he sought for other amendments.
5.

Therefore, in view of the submissions made by learned counsel for the revision petitioner and on perusing the record, this Court finds that dismissal of the application by the trial Court is not on proper appreciation of facts of law and it is liable to be set aside.
It is for the petitioner to prove his claim by adducing proper evidence both oral and documentary to get the required compensation.
6. In the result, the civil revision petition is allowed.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

__ P. SREE SUDHA, J Date: 12.01.2024 Bw THE HONOURABLE SMT JUSTICE P. SREE SUDHA CIVIL REVISION PETITION NO. 103 OF 2024 Date:12.01.2024 Bw Kurumalla Rajaiah vs Mrs Silviri Silivery Shayalaj on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168832032/
